[[Category:West Zenas Cemetery, Zenas, Indiana]]


== Biography ==
Ephraim Glasgow, eldest son of Samuel and Margaret (Jameson) Glasgow, married Oct. 18, 1832, Sarah N'orris, daughter of John and Ann Norris. She was born Feb. 25, 1813, in Kentucky. They resided in Indiana. Mr. Glasgow died Junes, 1845. Mrs. Glasgow died Aug. 27, 1872. They had eight children, viz.: Juliana, b. July 23, 1833, d. Aug. 14, 1834; William R., b. Jan. 17, 1835.111. Aug. 27, 1863, Ellen A. Hebbard ; John S., b. .March 9, 1837, d. Aug. 2, 1838;
